preconditions.description: Input constraints: string s length n, string t length m, and scissors parameter k satisfy 2 ≤ m ≤ 2·k ≤ n ≤ 5·10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in s) and all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in t)
preconditions.description: Both strings s and t consist of lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'No' or (stdout == 'Yes' and any(' '.join(map(str, [L, R])) in stdout for L in range(1, n - k + 2) for R in range(L + k, n - k + 2) if (L + k <= R) and (s[L-1:L+k-1] + s[R-1:R+k-1]).find(t) != -1))
postconditions.description: If possible, output 'Yes' followed by two 1-indexed integers L and R (start indices of the two non-intersecting substrings of length k in s) such that the concatenation of these substrings contains t as a substring. Otherwise, output 'No'.
